svg.title: Primary generic versus calibrated comparison
svg.desc: Participant-level false-alarm and miss rates for posture and screen-facing classification in frontal and off-axis conditions.
svg.text: Each dot is one participant; the black diamond is the median and the vertical line is the full P1–P4 range.
False-alarm rates condition on an explicit normal-segment verdict; missing posture input remains visible in the coverage tables.
Thresholds are frozen engineering values. Scripted instructions are reference labels, not clinical or independently observed ground truth.
